creates.message: Introduce Jesus to university students in 4 cards, and end with a way for them to send a prayer request
A Christmas outreach journey for families. Start with this nativity video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aqz-KE-bpKQ then ask what they thought of it
A follow-up journey for people who just watched the JESUS film: ask what they thought and offer next steps
A welcome journey for first-time visitors to our church: who we are, what Sunday looks like, and a way to tell us their name and email so we can say hi
A short devotional on Psalm 23 with one reflection question at the end
Help someone decide to follow Jesus. Explain the gospel simply, include a prayer they can pray, and a button saying 'I prayed this prayer'
A grief support journey: a few comforting verses, ask how they are feeling with a poll, and offer to talk by leaving their email
A quiz: how well do you know the Christmas story? Three poll questions, then a card with the answers
Youth camp interest check: which activities interest you (they can pick several), then their name and email
A calm 6-card journey on forgiveness for adults, light theme throughout
A respectful 5-card journey for Muslims who are curious about who Jesus is
A prayer request journey: what can we pray for (pick any), more details, and an optional email
Invite men to a Saturday breakfast at church: what to expect, why come, and RSVP with their name and email
A journey for people struggling with anxiety, with Bible verses and a link to read more at https://www.bible.com
Two cards: this video https://youtu.be/aqz-KE-bpKQ and then a question asking what stood out
